reviews.review:
Warframe is an incredibly immersive game, with an expansive library of lore and world-building that’s gone into it. Over the past 900 hours of gameplay in the last seven years I've been playing, Warframe has grown into a game that has something for everyone.

Want an open world to explore and go fishing in? The Plains of Eidolon, The Orb Vallis, and The Cambion Drift are places to go.
Want to focus more on thrashing your enemies? Exploring nodes on all the planets and beating up enemies is a path for you.
Want to catch them all? Focus on gathering resources and amassing a collection of weapons and frames to put others to shame.

Warframe has something for everyone, new players and old, and it never gets boring. With devs constantly adding new content, a responsive help team, and a dedicated and friendly community, Warframe is a game I could sink time into until arthritis sets in and I can’t play anymore.

10/10 recommend this game.

Pros: All of the above
Cons: The game can be a bit grindy at times, but that’s a huge part of what makes it fun.

(I have a further 1500 odd hours on xbox too) I'm gonna start this off by saying that the Devs are completely oblivious to the community and the state of the game. The game is fine while you're doing content for the first 5 or so times. Anyone who has played ALOT of this game knows that nothing the game considers endgame is actually hard. One could argue that the endgame is infinite with the endless level scaling in some missions. However, there's no real reason to do missions such as survival or defence past wave 20 in terms of the rewards you get for doing it. Its actually more efficient to restart the level instead of try to push your warframes and guns as far as they can go. As for content such as Eidolon hunts, which were supposed to be THE ENDGAME when they released, the community quickly found out the best strategy for these (just like people do in all games) and now completing 4-5 of these in one night cycle is a joke. Recently the devs have been releasing these new open worlds, and while they visually look amazing they are nothing but the same empty open world that they released the first time with a few added tweaks and changes here and there. In warframe there's always something that you CAN do, like farm for all the weapons and warframes, or grind for certain rare mods etc. However these things should be something that you do while going through the game, or while doing endgame content. They should not be the only purpose to play the game. As someone who has played warframe for thousands of hours, and I know there are people who have played the game since launch or played countless more hours than me, I think that if I stopped playing the game at about 5-600 hours I could be happy to walk away knowing that I've basically done everything the game has to offer. 

TL;DR
There is no endgame.
the devs don't play the game nor do they listen to the community
New content is lack lustre 
Content is far too easy for the complexity of builds that you can make - basically you can min-max the ♥♥♥♥ out of any gun or warframe but there's no worthwhile content to test this power on.

Trying to work out this mess of system upon system at this point is frankly barely worth the effort... great game if you have kept up from the start but trying to figure out the meta end game now will take some serious grinding and research.
I played a LOT because the melee style gameplay is fast and furious and fun, movement is impactful. 
But I can't pick it back up again after taking a hiatus.
